items.desc: Intense aromas of plum, Maraschino cherry with a rich and elegant palate with hints of spice and sweet tannins.

items.desc: Elegant tannins with dark red fruit and persistent finish. The fruit is always present, flanked by spices, flowers and balsamic notes.

items.desc: Aromas of red fruit, ripe cranberry, dark cherry, light spice, vanilla and old leather. On the palate, strawberry and cranberry with light tannin on the finish.

items.desc: Aromas of blackberry, black currant, black pepper, cedar and earthy notes. On the palate, soft tannins, medium body with black fruit flavors and mineral hints.

items.desc: Dark cherry, red raspberry, and orange zest aromas. Fresh flavors of dark and red cherry, black tea, and spice accents.

items.desc: Plummy, generous but with backbone, featuring rich flavors of fruit and herbs.
items.name: 2017 Brotherhood New York Premium Selection Merlot

items.desc: Magnificently expressive red with rich black fruits, licorice, blood orange and opulent hits of dark cocoa, finishing with firm tannins and an earthy spine.
items.name: 2021 Cathiard Vineyard Napa Valley Founding Brothers Bordeaux Blend

items.desc: Shows blackberry, graphite and violet notes as well as medium-plus tannins. Lots of red cherry on the finish, as well as some chocolate.

items.desc: Aromas of cherries, tea leaf and toffee. Smooth tannins, with a moderate finish on the palate.
items.name: 2019 Chateau Lafayette Reneau Finger Lakes Pinot Noir

items.src: Seneca Lake, New York · By the glass 12

items.name: 2019 Chateau Lafayette Reneau Finger Lakes Syrah

items.desc: Rustic aromas of stewed berries and wood spice with notes of cocoa and cigar box. Savory, meaty dark fruit on the palate with bramble, sweet spice and clove.
items.name: 2023 Damiani Wine Cellars Finger Lakes Cabernet Franc

items.desc: Medium body and balanced acidity with cranberry, red cherry, tobacco and tea notes.
items.name: 2021 Day Wines Johan Vineyards Van Duzer Corridor Pinot Noir

items.desc: Aromas of strawberry, raspberry and cola lead to mild red fruit and black pepper notes on the palate.

items.desc: Aromas of black cherry, blackberry, fig, fragrant florals, dried herbs and a touch of green peppercorn. On the palate, the wine is fruit-forward yet structured.

items.desc: Aromas and flavors of black cherries, cassis, vanilla, chocolate and tobacco with silky tannins.

items.desc: Leading with fresh plums and red berries with vivid violet scents, the wine evolves from its bright and fruity core to a spicy richness on the palate.

data.intro: An intimate, multi-course tasting dinner cooked over our wood-fired hearth. Chef Rich Strub built the menu around seasonal ingredients and global flavors, and sommelier Keenan Davis chose two tiers of wine to accompany each course.
notes: Guests chose a wine pairing tier when booking, one pairing per guest.
Dietary restrictions were noted in the special-note box when reserving.
Special requests could not be accommodated on the day of the dinner.
